prompt: Leave the voicemail your dad leaves after you already texted him that your flight landed.
response:
*beep*

Hey, it's Dad. Just calling to see if your flight landed okay. Haven't heard anything, so... just give me a call when you get this. Or text. Whichever. Your mother wants to know too.

Uh, let's see, what else... Oh — did you check the weather out there? Supposed to get cold this week, I saw on the news. Hope you packed that jacket. The good one, not the thin one.

Also, when you get a second, no rush — the printer's doing that thing again. Where it says it's offline but it's not offline. I unplugged it like you said. Didn't work. Anyway. Not urgent.

Okay, well. Call your old man when you land. Or if you already landed, call anyway. Alright.

Love you. It's Dad, by the way.

*beep*
